scientific_integrity: An analytic proof accompanies a reproducible finite corroboration. All-dimensional claims follow from the proof, not finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a fixed-dimensional asymptotic, not an exact count; no classification is claimed on deeper equal-absolute-frequency collisions. The generic Fourier formula is classical background and the three-/four-dimensional analogues are prior results. Historical priority of the higher-dimensional parity law remains provisional pending independent assessment.
title: Parity-sharp lattice Fourier sparsity of high-dimensional cross-polytopes
